description: This file defines the EmployeeTrackerSearchFilterParams class in the OrangeHRM performance module. It extends the FilterParams class and provides filtering parameters for employee tracker searches, including sorting options and employee inclusion criteria.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object that encapsulates filtering parameters for employee tracker search operations within the OrangeHRM performance module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with default sorting field ('tracker.modifiedDate') and sort order (descending).

methods.name: getTrackerIds
methods.description: Returns the array of tracker IDs to filter for specific trackers.

methods.name: setTrackerIds
methods.description: Sets the array of tracker IDs for filtering.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number for filtering.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for filtering.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves the current setting for including employees (current, past, or both).

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion criteria for employees in the filter.
